title: Special Project Strategist Graduate (TikTok Shop - Electronics, Books, Hardlines & Virtual Goods) - 2027 Start (MBA)

deadline.evidence: Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis.

application_cap.evidence: Candidates can apply to a maximum of two positions

materials_required.evidence: Please state your availability and graduation date clearly in your resume.

degree_requirement.evidence: Individuals who are completing or have recently completed an MBA degree.

responsibilities: Be familiar with the overall strategies and tactics of global e-commerce business, and deeply support business leaders to disassemble project tasks, set priorities and add value to the business team
Develop and execute comprehensive strategy, including goal/budget setting and performance review
Conduct data analysis to evaluate the performance of merchandise and seller growth, identify trends, and make recommendations for optimization
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to plan and execute the Strategy
Participate in the design and implementation of business operation management systems and processes, and provide strong support for the implementation of business strategy
Proactively identify and mitigate risk during rapid growth in business development, while ensuring regulatory and policy compliance is maintained
Establish a clear and efficient communication mechanism with internal and external partners globally, coordinate projects across systems and departments, and improve overall synergy efficiency
